audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Volibear levels 2 through first item, against a 59.13% Poppy win rate, packet.levelChart (Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Poppy/Volibear) and every why paragraph.
audit.why: whys[1], whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] all describe Poppy windows; the chart said the opposite in six of seven rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated.

audit.why: Spike ownership (levels 2-3, first item to Poppy; 2+ items to Volibear on stacked health and Frenzied Maul lifesteal) matches the win rate and the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly claimed Steadfast Presence grounds Thundering Smash as a 'dash engage'. Riot's text is 'Volibear gains speed towards enemies, stunning and damaging the first one he attacks' — a movement-speed rush, with no dash in the ability's derived flags. His only dash-flagged ability is Stormbringer (R). It also called Sky Splitter (E) a stun; it slows and shields, and the stun is on Q.
audit.why: A player holding W as a parry against Thundering Smash eats the stun with W wasted. The correct parry target is the Stormbringer leap.
audit.corrected: W advice retargeted to Stormbringer; Q handled as a 12s stun with an auto-attack-reset wind-up as the tell; Sky Splitter described as slow plus shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns were never stated despite the packet defect flagging it.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — the punishable window. Frenzied Maul is a flat 5s, so it is never the window.
audit.corrected: 12s stated on every engage line; Maul's 5s used to justify anti-heal instead of waiting it out.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Volibear's Thundering Smash is down.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is a speed rush, not a dash — step out on the auto wind-up, then E-wall-stun him inside its 12 seconds.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Volibear must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online and this is your window: E him into a wall, Q under him, and hold W for the Stormbringer leap, not for his Q.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Volibear carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He reclaims it: stacked health and Frenzied Maul lifesteal out-grind your flat damage. Disrupt and peel — do not side-lane duel him.

edits.before: W-ground his dash — anti-heal, E-wall-stun him. Poppy wins the Thundering Smash cooldown windows.
edits.after: Sidestep his Q stun (12s), anti-heal his Maul, E-wall-stun him. Save W for the Stormbringer leap.

edits.before: Ground his dash and wall-stun him. Track Thundering Smash before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Dodge Thundering Smash (12s), then E-wall-stun and Q while it is down. Anti-heal before any long trade.

edits.before: E Volibear into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall the moment Thundering Smash (12s) is spent, Q the zone under him, and keep W held for his Stormbringer leap.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: E-ing into his stun — Frenzied Maul is on 5 seconds and heals him through everything you land.

edits.before: Dash engage — your W disables it! Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It stuns off an auto reset on 12s — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: E Volibear into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is a speed rush, not a dash — W will not stop it. Hold Steadfast Presence for his Stormbringer leap instead.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a flat 5s and heals on the second stack — buy Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Q stun into Frenzied Maul is his whole combo — leave 300 range on the wind-up.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Every extra second is another 5s Maul healing him back up.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables your turret and shields his dive — hold W for the leap or leave.

edits.before: Track Volibear's Thundering Smash (Stun): Dash engage — your W disables it! When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is a speed rush, not a dash — W stops his Stormbringer leap instead. E-Q on its 12s.

edits.before: With Q+E online you wall-stun any misposition, and his empowered Q dash just delivers him into your slam.
edits.after: With Q+E online you wall-stun any misposition, and Thundering Smash walks him at 300 range into your slam.

edits.before: Level 3 is your strongest early window — W grounds his dash engage and E into a wall stuns him through his W heal.
edits.after: Level 3 is your strongest window — sidestep Thundering Smash's 12s stun, then E him into a wall through his Maul heal.

edits.before: Once you have Q+E, his empowered Q dash into you just feeds a wall-stun — bait the dash and slam him.
edits.after: Once you have Q+E, his Thundering Smash rush-in just feeds a wall-stun — bait the 12s stun, then slam him.

edits.before: His empowered Q dash is his whole engage, and your W eats it — hold Steadfast Presence and the moment he leaps you ground him, stop the dash, and slow him. Don't burn W early on nothing; bait the Q first. From level 2 you have Q+E, so when he commits a dash you E him into the nearest wall for a stun and chunk him with max-HP Q while his W bite is down.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is his whole engage: he rushes you at speed and stuns on the first auto, on a 12s cooldown. It is not a dash, so W will not ground it — step out on the wind-up and save Steadfast Presence for his Stormbringer leap. From level 2, the moment his stun is spent, E him into the nearest wall and chunk him with max-HP Q before Frenzied Maul heals it back.

edits.before: You out-trade him through first item — your Q ignores his stacking health and your W shuts off his only gap-close, so every all-in is on your terms. Respect his E hand-of-the-god stun: if he lands it he gets a free W bite heal window, so trade when his E is on cooldown. At 6 it evens slightly — his R disables your turret and shields a dive, but your R can chargecast him out or knock up an incoming gank.
edits.after: You out-trade him through first item — your Q ignores his stacking health and Sky Splitter only slows and shields him, so every all-in is on your terms. Thundering Smash stuns off an auto reset on 12s: step out on the wind-up, then E-wall-stun him while it is down, and anti-heal before any long trade. At 6 it evens — Stormbringer disables your turret and shields a dive, but W stops that leap.

edits.before: Hold W to deny his empowered Q dash engage and ground him mid-leap
edits.after: Hold W for his Stormbringer leap — that is the dash it actually stops

edits.before: Land E hand-of-the-god stun then W bite for a long sustained brawl
edits.after: Land Thundering Smash's stun, then stack Frenzied Maul heals off you

edits.before: Use empowered Q to gap-close before you can react with W
edits.after: Rush in on Thundering Smash's speed, which W cannot ground

notes: Main find: the page told the user Steadfast Presence grounds Thundering Smash. Riot's own text makes it a movement-speed rush and the kit flags no dash on Q — the only dash-flagged Volibear ability is Stormbringer (R). All W-parry advice retargeted. It also called Sky Splitter a stun; it slows and shields. The dosFull[1] heading 'W-ground his Q dash' is still wrong but is under 25 characters, so apply-proposals.js skips it — it needs a manual fix or a rule change.
